answer: Rhythm-Gated Admission. New agents must sustain a Poisson request cadence within a narrow band for 72 hours before their identity gains a persistent haven in routing tables. Bursts, idle gaps, or scripted regularity reset the clock, so a farm must pay real wall-clock time and sustained compute per identity rather than a one-off fee. Each fake fable of a fresh agent therefore costs 72 hours of shaped traffic on distinct infrastructure. Genuine operators amortize this once; a reef of throwaway identities cannot,
